item.title: Christopher Boyle Co-Founder of Fabrum - NZ Business Podcast
item.description: Christopher Boyle shares about Fabrum’s innovative beginnings, breakthroughs in cryogenic and composite technologies, global partnerships with NASA and Rolls Royce, and the future of liquid hydrogen for aviation and industry. Gain insights into the challenges of advanced manufacturing, lessons in resilience, and the crucial role of Kiwi innovation in shaping world-first solutions.

item.title: Janine Grainger Co-Founder of Easy Crypto - NZ Business Podcast
item.description: Easy Crypto co-founder Janine Grainger shares her early ventures, insights from banking and corporate, and the regulatory hurdles that shaped Easy Crypto’s growth. The conversation explores the challenges of building a crypto business, leading through volatility, and the importance of resilience for founders.

item.title: Aaron Ward - AskNicely and Huckleberry Co-Founder - NZ Business Podcast
item.description: Join host Paul Spain as he chats with Aaron Ward about his journey building global tech businesses like Ask Nicely. Discover insights on entrepreneurship, startup lessons, navigating challenges, and Aaron Ward's latest venture, Huckleberry. Perfect for anyone interested in Kiwi business success, growth mindset, and real-world founder wisdom.

item.title: Jamie Beaton - Founder and CEO of Crimson Education 2020 Interview - NZ Business Podcast
item.description: Discover how Jamie Beaton scaled Crimson Education into a global education leader, the challenges of international growth, key lessons in entrepreneurship, and the innovative vision behind Crimson Global Academy—New Zealand’s first online high school. Insightful reflections on leadership, ambition, and leveraging technology for education.

item.title: Bowen Pan - Tech Leader, Advisor and Facebook Marketplace Pioneer - NZ Business Podcast
item.description: Host Paul Spain sits down with Bowen Pan, former Facebook Marketplace product leader, to unpack his journey from Kiwi entrepreneur to Silicon Valley innovator. Hear stories of launching Facebook Marketplace, lessons from Trade Me and Stripe, and why New Zealand’s growing tech scene is ready for global impact.

item.title: Rob Woolner – Managing Director at Autex Acoustics - NZ Business Podcast
item.description: Host Paul Spain talks with Rob Woolner, Autex Managing Director, about sustainability, leadership, personal growth, and how a Kiwi company became a global acoustic leader.

item.title: Sam Kidd – Co-Founder and CEO of LawVu - NZ Business Podcast
item.description: Sam Kidd Co-founder and CEO of LawVu shares lessons and insights on building a global legal tech business from New Zealand.

item.title: Lachlan Murray - Founder and CEO of Robomate - NZ Business Podcast
item.description: Lachlan Murray, Founder and CEO of Robomate shares his journey building Robomate from a small robotics idea into a nationwide home‑automation leader. Lachlan founded Robomate in 2018 and bootstrapped the company through early setbacks, refining the model through relentless problem‑solving and customer focus. item.title: Sam Vye: Founder and CEO of Syos - NZ Business Podcast
item.description: Sam Vye, founder and CEO of Syos, shares his journey of entrepreneurship, rapid business growth, overcoming challenges, team culture, and insights into the evolving drone industry for both civil and defence sectors.

item.title: Claudia Batten: Tech Entrepreneur, Advisor and Board Member - NZ Business Podcast
item.description: Learn how Claudia Batten went from a legal career in Wellington to co-founding a successful tech startup acquired by Microsoft, and discover her advice on team alignment, resilience, boardroom dynamics, and the power of curiosity in business.
